    intro hx0
    apply hx
    rw [hx0]

  have hInvNeZero : x⁻¹ ≠ 0 := inv_ne_zero hx0
  have hmem : x⁻¹ ∈ Set.range ((↑) : ℚ → ℝ) := by
    by_contra hmem'
    exact h hmem'
  obtain ⟨q, hq⟩ := hmem

    intro hq0

    rw [hqCastZero] at hq
    exact hInvNeZero hq.symm

      _ = (q : ℝ)⁻¹ := by rw [hq.symm]

  exact hx ⟨q⁻¹, hx_eq.symm⟩
